checks.question: Machine the supplied 200 mm long octagonal stock into a sleeve without changing its outer profile, length or pose. Add a centred diameter-12 mm axial through-bore. At both ends, add a concentric diameter-20 mm counterbore 15 mm deep, measured inward from that end. Add two diameter-6 mm cross-holes parallel to X, centred at Y = 0 and at Z = 80 and 120 mm above the original bottom face. Each cross-hole must pass through both sides and connect openly to the axial bore. Leave sharp internal shoulders; do not add unspecified chamfers or fillets. The final object is a single closed connected solid with real communicating passages.；按本题允许修改范围检查形态或照明变化，N中已计的尺寸/数量不在此重复计分。
